text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!
This detail, this presence... It's incredible!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "On a rest day just before the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, I was touring a palace famous for its beautiful architecture together with Kiseki."
choice_data_list: This'll make great reference material for manga.
This'll make great reference material for manga.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It'll be super useful when drawing fantasy works!
That suit of armor from earlier was truly amazing too—
choice_data_list: (She seems even more excited than usual!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, got plenty of photos!
We visited everywhere we wanted to see, so next—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Focus on the race... huh?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Rain?
Even though the sky is so clear.
choice_data_list: It's a sunshower... Let's take shelter for a bit.
It's a sunshower... Let's take shelter for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ducked into the shade of the trees with Kiseki, but...
it seems it was just a passing shower, and it stopped right away.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, good thing you didn't get wet! You definitely wouldn't want to catch a cold before the race!
choice_data_list: The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is right around the corner, after all.
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is right around the corner, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's true~...
Still... yeah, okay, I see, I see...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I'm thinking about how things might play out.
Like, what if it rains during the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe'...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...A turf heavy with rain.
Feet slipping, a grueling struggle for everyone. But—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Winning there is what makes a true protagonist!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "The challenge to take on the world, etched by our predecessors. And now, the protagonist will challenge—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The barrier no one has yet reached, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!
I will surpass overwhelmingly strong rivals and seize victory!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
An utterly unpredictable development... This will definitely be amazing!
We'll be able to send the whole world into a frenzy!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For example, breaking away from the pack early on to take the lead!
Outlasting the world's best in a contest of stamina—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Front-running all the way to 1st place without letting anyone close!
...Woah, what a thrilling race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It's a race where even just winning is unprecedented.
Painting a dramatic outcome might be
even more difficult. However――"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If it's Kiseki—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer!
How was that race development just now?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: No matter the hardship, Kiseki can overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh! Yes!!
Right, that's exactly right!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even a victory that seems like fiction...
Together, we can make it reality!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, let's have a strategy meeting!
I want to make the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe even more exciting!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go all the way!
Yeah, let's go all the way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's deliver this fervor to the world together—
Together with Kiseki, we passionately discussed what the future holds.
